5 shift/reduce conflicts resolved

state:
  expression -> expression "*" expression •
  expression -> expression • "*" expression
  expression -> expression • "+" expression

  shift/reduce conflict on terminal "*":
    shift (chosen)
    reduce: expression -> expression "*" expression
    ambiguous for expression:
      example: expression "*" expression • "*" expression
      using the reduction:
        expression -> [expression] "*" expression
          expression -> expression "*" expression •
      using the shift:
        expression -> expression "*" [expression]
          expression -> expression • "*" expression

  shift/reduce conflict on terminal "+":
    shift (chosen)
    reduce: expression -> expression "*" expression
    ambiguous for expression:
      example: expression "*" expression • "+" expression
      using the reduction:
        expression -> [expression] "+" expression
          expression -> expression "*" expression •
      using the shift:
        expression -> expression "*" [expression]
          expression -> expression • "+" expression

state:
  statement -> "if" expression "then" statement •
  statement -> "if" expression "then" statement • "else" statement

  shift/reduce conflict on terminal "else":
    shift (chosen)
    reduce: statement -> "if" expression "then" statement
    ambiguous for statement:
      example: "if" expression "then" "if" expression "then" statement • "else" statement
      using the reduction:
        statement -> "if" expression "then" [statement] "else" statement
          statement -> "if" expression "then" statement •
      using the shift:
